R: what the game is made of

prompt.start: Read AGENTS.md (shared rules + the work loop), then {root}/AGENTS.md and the HANDOFF.md top block. Then run `npm run issue -- show <ID>` for your ticket - do not read the whole docs/BACKLOG.md.
prompt.rules: Game rules: npm run firewall before every commit; never print story text; never modify the install. Commit locally only - never push or deploy. When done: npm run issue -- done {id}, npm run issue -- audit, update HANDOFF.md.
